records.source: Feast of the Winter Star
records.translation: Piging ng Bituin ng Taglamig

records.source: I wonder if I could lick one of those canes...
records.translation: Maaari ko kayang dilaan ang isa sa mga baston na iyon...

records.source: I'm thankful for our simple life on the farm.$h
records.translation: Nagpapasalamat ako sa simple nating buhay sa bukid.$h

records.source: Hey, @. I'm ready to head home whenever you are.
records.translation: Hoy, @. Handa na akong umuwi kapag handa ka na.

records.source: I'm thankful to have met you...$l
records.translation: Nagpapasalamat akong nakilala kita...$l

records.source: Me?... Oh, I'm thankful for... how about I just show you when we get home tonight?$l
records.translation: Ako?... Oh, nagpapasalamat ako sa... paano kung ipakita ko na lang sa iyo pag-uwi natin mamayang gabi?$l

records.source: Hey, @. As you can see, I'm fulfilling my family obligations...
records.translation: Hoy, @. Gaya ng nakikita mo, ginagampanan ko ang mga tungkulin ko sa pamilya...

records.source: *yawn*... I'm here for the gifts and the cookies.$h
records.translation: *hikab*... Narito ako para sa mga regalo at biskwit.$h

records.source: What am I thankful for? I'll show you when we get back home...$l
records.translation: Ano ang ipinagpapasalamat ko? Ipapakita ko sa iyo pag-uwi natin...$l

records.source: I'm feeling a little overwhelmed... thank goodness for this crisp air...$l
records.translation: Medyo nalulula ako... salamat sa sariwang hanging ito...$l

records.source: You don't need to get me anything, you've already given me the greatest gift of all...$l
records.translation: Hindi mo kailangang regaluhan ako; naibigay mo na sa akin ang pinakadakilang regalo sa lahat...$l

records.source: Nothing like a piping hot feast on a cold winter's day, huh?$h
records.translation: Walang tatalo sa mainit na piging sa malamig na araw ng taglamig, hindi ba?$h

records.source: Hiya, @. You're welcome to join our family table if you need company.$h
records.translation: Hoy, @. Maaari kang sumalo sa hapag ng pamilya namin kung kailangan mo ng kasama.$h

records.source: I'll probably get another tool set this year... *sigh*
records.translation: Malamang na isa na namang hanay ng mga kasangkapan ang matatanggap ko ngayong taon... *buntong-hininga*

records.source: Hi, @.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @.$h

records.source: I've met some people who believe in spirits, and magic... but me? I've never seen anything that couldn't be explained by science.
records.translation: May nakilala akong mga taong naniniwala sa mga espiritu at mahika... pero ako? Wala pa akong nakitang hindi maipaliliwanag ng agham.

records.source: Spending time with family is tiring sometimes.
records.translation: Nakakapagod kung minsan ang makasama ang pamilya.

records.source: My sales figures have been phenomenal lately... thanks to the Feast of the Winter Star!$h#$e#Boy, holidays are good for business. I wonder if I could invent some new ones...
records.translation: Kahanga-hanga ang mga benta ko nitong mga huli... salamat sa Piging ng Bituin ng Taglamig!$h#$e#Naku, mahusay sa negosyo ang mga pista. Baka makaimbento ako ng mga bago...

records.source: Ooohh... I've had too much nog.$h
records.translation: Ooohh... Naparami ang nainom kong eggnog.$h

records.source: I'd join in... but I don't think I'm welcome.$s
records.translation: Sasali sana ako... pero palagay ko'y hindi ako tanggap dito.$s

records.source: Oh, hello.$s
records.translation: Oh, kumusta.$s

records.source: A feast for some stupid star? Humbug!
records.translation: Piging para sa isang hangal na bituin? Kalokohan!

records.source: Oh, my! Aren't you cold, dear? It's freezing!
records.translation: Naku! Hindi ka ba nilalamig, mahal? Napakaginaw!

records.source: Today is a time to be thankful for this year's good fortune. Forget your worries for a day and relax!
records.translation: Panahon ngayon upang magpasalamat sa magandang kapalaran ngayong taon. Kalimutan ang mga alalahanin nang isang araw at magpahinga!

records.source: *sigh*... All these happy families. But for me, just another lonely year.
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Lahat ng masasayang pamilyang ito. Pero para sa akin, isa na namang malungkot na taon.

records.source: $y '@! What are you hoping to find under the spirit tree?_A new watering can._All work and no play? That's not very fun.$s_A jug of spiced mead._Ooo... that sounds nice. Make sure to give me a taste.$h_A pair of stylish boots._I see. That would be a great gift!'
records.translation: $y '@! Ano ang inaasahan mong makita sa ilalim ng punong-espiritu?_Isang bagong Pandilig._Puro trabaho at walang laro? Hindi iyon masaya.$s_Isang pitsel ng pulot-alak na may rekado._Ooo... parang masarap iyon. Tiyaking patikimin mo ako.$h_Isang pares ng makabagong bota._Nauunawaan ko. Magiging magandang regalo iyon!'

records.source: What a beautiful tree.$h
records.translation: Napakagandang puno.$h

records.source: Hmmph... I'm still upset I didn't win the ice fishing competition.$4
records.translation: Hmph... Naiinis pa rin akong hindi ako nanalo sa paligsahan sa pangingisda sa yelo.$4

records.source: I hope there's a new camera for me under the spirit tree!
records.translation: Sana may bagong kamera para sa akin sa ilalim ng punong-espiritu!
